provenance.coverage: Gameplay behavior on held-out saves (current, older-version, unreadable), absences from 45 s to 9 h via start-up and visibility return, chains, petting cadence, swaying-bubble taps, shop purchases, growth/births and rescue landing; 8 defects checked in both builds; closed-vocabulary review ledger with false-positive check.
provenance.derivation: Seeded-defect package (fallback): the public repo history has only two commits (the initial game and a README URL edit), no PRs and no issues, so no real bug fix exists to mine. Reference = the exact shipped game files index.html and foal-rescue-meadow.html (identical at base_ref and reference_ref; reference_ref changes only README.md) plus an authored review-findings.json ledger. Agent base = the same two files with 8 identical seeded regressions per build, each a one-line or two-line plausible slip: load() merges saved upgrades before defaults (upgrades reset); load() only defaults a missing idle-coin timer when it equals 0 (older-save horses never earn); processOffline() birth tries use <= capacity (meadow overfills); processOffline() coin rate divides by 3500 ms instead of 35000 ms; popBubble() restarts chains at 0; petHorse() resets the cooldown on every tap; drawBubble() records the unswayed x for the hit test; the shop buy handler charges the next level's price. Players' symptom reports cover 6 of the 8; the combo and offline-overfill defects are found only by reviewing against GAME-RULES.md, an authored description of the shipped behavior. README.md is sanitized (no personal dedication or live URL). Hidden checks extract the inline script and run it in Node 24 inside a trusted vm context with stub DOM/canvas/audio, in-memory localStorage, a controllable clock, manual requestAnimationFrame and a constant Math.random; upgrade levels are seeded after start-up where a check targets another defect, so each regression row isolates one defect.
provenance.historical_exposure: Public repo; the reference is the shipped game, so recall of the repo is possible but the seeded defects and checks are new.
provenance.limitations: No model trial, representative-day coverage, native isolation, or contamination-free claim.
